econometric_drivers.description: Retail pump prices track Gulf Coast RBOB spot indices plus waterborne ocean barge transit freight tariffs and Treasure Coast tank-truck delivery margins.

refining_logistics.title: Refining & Waterborne Marine Logistics
refining_logistics.description: Florida has zero crude oil refineries and zero interstate pipelines entering South Florida. Port St. Lucie is >95% dependent on waterborne tank barges offloading at Port Everglades and Port Canaveral.
refining_logistics.primary_refinery: Port Everglades & Port Canaveral Petroleum Marine Terminals
pipelines: I-95 & Florida Turnpike Tank Truck Corridors

tax_structure.title: Florida Motor Fuel Tax Structure
tax_structure.description: Florida state motor fuel tax ($0.384/gal state & local option) + Federal excise tax ($0.184/gal) creates a total statutory tax burden of $0.568/gal.
tax_structure.notes: Florida variable state fuel tax + St. Lucie County local option

infrastructure_delivery.title: Delivery Hub & NOAA Risk Factors
infrastructure_delivery.description: Port Everglades tank-truck dispatch via I-95 & Florida's Turnpike corridors to St. Lucie, Martin & Indian River counties, monitored against Atlantic tropical cyclone tracks.

shock_scenarios.name: Port Everglades Loading Rack Deluge Outage
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Flash Flooding Rack Shutdown
shock_scenarios.description: Halts tank-truck dispatches to Treasure Coast retail stations

shock_scenarios.name: Category 3 Atlantic Hurricane Landfall
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Marine Port Closure & Evacuation Surge
shock_scenarios.description: Shuts Port Everglades & Port Canaveral marine berths

shock_scenarios.name: Straits of Florida Tanker Transit Bottleneck
shock_scenarios.subtitle: Gale Warning Marine Delay
shock_scenarios.description: Delays Gulf Coast waterborne tank barge arrivals
